title_en: The Lady of the Pandanus Grove
note: 每個 line：kind=narr 為華語旁白；kind=tw 為台語台詞（tl 為台羅，供 TTS）。scene 對應 render.html 的場景。pad 為該句結束後的停頓秒數。 t00 為開場鉤子：黑畫面中先聽到林投姐的台語問句（倒敘預告），之後燈籠亮起、畫面淡入。

lines.speaker: lady
lines.zh: 頭家，肉粽一粒偌濟錢？
lines.tl: Thâu-ke, bah-tsàng tsi̍t lia̍p guā-tsē tsînn?
lines.en: Sir... how much for a zongzi?

lines.zh: 清朝咸豐年間，台南府城東門外。
lines.en: Tainan, during the Xianfeng reign of the Qing dynasty. Outside the East Gate.

lines.zh: 夜深了，一個賣肉粽的小販，提著燈籠，走過林投樹林。
lines.en: Late at night, a zongzi peddler walks past the pandanus grove with his lantern.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.zh: 頭家，肉粽一粒偌濟錢？
lines.tl: Thâu-ke, bah-tsàng tsi̍t lia̍p guā-tsē tsînn?
lines.en: Sir... how much for a zongzi?

lines.zh: 一個白衣女子，低著頭，從樹影裡走出來。
lines.en: A woman in white steps out of the shadows, her head bowed.

lines.zh: 她每晚都來，買了肉粽，就消失在林投樹後。
lines.en: She comes every night, buys a zongzi, and vanishes behind the trees.

lines.zh: 直到某天清晨，小販打開錢筒——
lines.en: Until one morning, the peddler opens his money box...

lines.zh: 裡面的銅錢，全變成了冥紙。
lines.en: ...and every copper coin has turned into joss paper for the dead.

lines.zh: 她是誰？故事，要從幾年前說起。
lines.en: Who was she? The story begins years earlier.

lines.zh: 府城有位寡婦，名叫李昭娘。
lines.en: In the city lived a widow named Li Zhao-niang.

lines.zh: 丈夫病逝，留下一筆家產，她獨自拉拔三個孩子。
lines.en: Her husband had died, leaving her a fortune and three children to raise alone.

lines.zh: 這時，一個從唐山來的商人周亞思，出現在她面前。
lines.en: Then a merchant from the mainland, Zhou Ya-si, appeared at her door.

lines.zh: 他甜言蜜語，說要娶她、一起做生意。
lines.en: With sweet words, he promised marriage and a business together.

lines.zh: 昭娘，把全部家當都交給了他。
lines.en: And Zhao-niang gave him everything she had.

lines.zh: 周亞思說要回唐山辦貨，船一開，就再也沒有回來。
lines.en: He sailed home to buy goods, he said. The ship left, and never returned.

lines.zh: 後來才聽說，他在汕頭，早已另有妻室。
lines.en: Later she learned he already had a wife waiting in Shantou.

lines.zh: 家財散盡，孩子們也沒能活下來。
lines.en: Her fortune was gone. Her children did not survive.

lines.zh: 一個風雨夜，昭娘走進東門外的林投樹林，再也沒有出來。
lines.en: One stormy night, she walked into the pandanus grove, and never came out.

lines.zh: 從此，林投樹下夜夜傳出哭聲，人們叫她——林投姐。
lines.en: From then on, weeping was heard beneath the trees each night. People called her the Lady of the Pandanus.

lines.zh: 直到有一天夜裡，一位從唐山來的術士，路過林投樹林。
lines.en: Then one night, a Taoist master from the mainland passed by the pandanus grove.

lines.zh: 林子深處，隱隱傳來女人的哭聲。
lines.en: From deep in the grove came the faint sound of a woman weeping.

lines.zh: 他提燈循聲走去，只見一個白衣女子，背對著他，站在林投樹下。
lines.en: Following the sound with his lantern, he found a woman in white, standing beneath a pandanus tree, her back to him.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.zh: 你……毋驚我？
lines.en: You... are not afraid of me?

lines.zh: 術士沒有逃，反而問她為何在此哭泣。她便把被騙的經過，一五一十說了出來。
lines.en: He did not flee. He asked why she wept, and she told him everything: how she had been deceived.

lines.zh: 說完，她跪了下來。
lines.en: Then she knelt before him.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.zh: 師父，求你𤆬我過海，我欲討一个公道。
lines.tl: Sai-hū, kiû lí tshuā guá kuè-hái, guá beh thó tsi̍t ê kong-tō.
lines.en: Master... please take me across the sea. I want justice.

lines.zh: 術士聽完她的遭遇，答應幫她，讓她的魂魄藏進一把油紙傘裡。
lines.en: Moved by her story, he agreed, and let her spirit hide inside an oil-paper umbrella.

lines.zh: 術士一路帶著這把傘，渡過黑水溝，來到汕頭。
lines.en: He carried the umbrella across the Black Ditch strait, all the way to Shantou.

lines.zh: 到了汕頭，術士四處打聽，找到了周亞思。
lines.en: In Shantou, the master asked around, and found Zhou Ya-si.

lines.zh: 他靠著昭娘的錢開了大商號，娶妻生子，日子過得風光。
lines.en: With Zhao-niang's money he had opened a grand shop, married, had children, and lived in comfort.

lines.zh: 那天深夜，術士在周家門口撐開了油紙傘，一縷白煙鑽進了門縫。
lines.en: Late that night, the master opened the umbrella at Zhou's door, and a wisp of white smoke slipped through the crack.

lines.zh: 屋裡，周亞思正在燈下算帳，燈火忽然變成藍色。
lines.en: Inside, Zhou was counting his money by lamplight, when the flame turned blue.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.zh: 頭家……肉粽一粒偌濟錢？
lines.tl: Thâu-ke... bah-tsàng tsi̍t lia̍p guā-tsē tsînn?
lines.en: Sir... how much for a zongzi?

lines.speaker: lady
lines.zh: 周亞思，你欠我的，今仔日愛還！
lines.tl: Tsiu A-su, lí khiàm guá--ê, kin-á-ji̍t ài hîng!
lines.en: Zhou Ya-si... today you pay what you owe me!

lines.zh: 周亞思跪在地上，拚命磕頭求饒。
lines.en: Zhou fell to his knees, begging for mercy.

lines.speaker: zhou
lines.zh: 昭娘，是我毋著，饒我一條命！
lines.tl: Tsiau-niû, sī guá m̄-tio̍h, jiâu guá tsi̍t tiâu miā!
lines.en: Zhao-niang, I was wrong! Spare my life!

lines.zh: 林投姐一句話也沒有說。燈火，熄了。
lines.en: She said nothing at all. The lamp went out.

lines.zh: 幾天後，周家大門貼上了白紙。人們說，周亞思發了瘋，在驚恐中死去。
lines.en: Days later, white mourning paper hung on Zhou's gate. People said he had gone mad, and died in terror.

lines.zh: 直到今天，台南人仍會說起——
lines.en: To this day, people in Tainan still speak of her...

lines.zh: 深夜裡，林投樹下，那個來買肉粽的女人。
lines.en: the woman who comes, late at night, beneath the pandanus trees, to buy a zongzi.

lines.speaker: lady
lines.zh: 頭家……肉粽，閣有無？
lines.en: Sir... any zongzi left?
